newsitem.title: USA: American Surgery holders OK reverse split.
newsitem.headline: American Surgery holders OK reverse split.

text.p: American Surgery Centers Corp said Tuesday its shareholders had approved a one-for-10 reverse stock split.
In addition, shareholders approved a change of the company's name to Daleigh Holdings Corp and the nomination of two members to a reconstituted board of directors.

"Over the next few months, we expect to be able to announce several new ventures for our company relating to the delivery of health-care services and efficient practice management," Lee Rodriguez, chairman, said in a statement.
Shareholders approved the nominations of Rodriguez as chairman and Dr. Ahmad Moradi as a board member.
Rodriguez joined American Surgery last May. Moradi has more than 15 years' experience in developing and advising companies on management issues and technology.
